The included exact-fraction standard-library checker successfully tested 16 shape cases and 1725 rational points; finite checks are additional verification, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The complete all-face Euclidean foot locus is a geometrically motivated admissible-center region. Its continuous one-axis deformation produces a true polyhedral combinatorial collapse, a sharp two-branch volume law, a uniquely maximizing regular octahedron with quantitative quadratic deficit, and a third-order singularity at the transition. This continuous classification and stability were not implied by the previously published single regular case; a precise natural invariant is determined without asserting unsupported generality.
